name: Heartbeat Scramble
original_name: ハートビートスクランブル
source:
Game reproduces events of graduating school year, such as attending part-time job, participating in clubs and school festivals as well as getting along with the girls and inviting them on a date and maybe even spending vacations together with one of them.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/08/vn-of-month-september-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
游戏再现了毕业学年的事件，例如打工、参加俱乐部和学园祭以及与女孩们相处并邀请她们约会，甚至可能与其中一个人一起度假。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/08/vn-of-month-september-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
